cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: This doesn't look right to me. `_pendingVisibility` is represents the queued state. `_visibility` represents the current state. So it shouldn't be set until the commit phase.

evidence.thread_resolution: sammy-SC: I changed it so `attachOffscreenInstance` and `detachOffscreenInstance` only read/write to `_pendingVisibility` and `_pendingVisibility` is synced with `_visibility` in `beginWork`.
